prerequisites: It is recommended that the student has passed Mathematics I and II from the first year of the Degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge in a field of study that starts from the basis of general secondary education, and is usually at a level that, while relying on advanced textbooks, also includes some aspects involving knowledge from the forefront of their field of study.

Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge of: linear algebra; geometry; differential geometry; differential and integral calculus; ordinary and partial differential equations; numerical methods; numerical algorithms; statistics and optimization.

syllabus_topics: Functions of Several Variables; Scalar Fields, Vector Fields, Trajectories and Surfaces; Level Sets
Differentiation of Functions of Several Variables; Partial Derivatives; Derivative Matrix; Chain Rule; Directional Derivative; Nabla Operator; Applications
Differential Geometry; Parametrized Curves and Surfaces
Multiple Integrals; Changes of Variable; Applications
Line Integrals and Surface Integrals, of Scalar and Vector Fields; Reparameterizations; Applications
Green's Theorem; Gauss's Theorem; Stokes' Theorem; Applications
PDEs; Classical Equations; Method of Separation of Variables; Fourier Series
teaching_methods: Computer practices in the computer lab with Mathematica software

assessment_methods.method: Completion of Assignments, Cases, or Exercises

assessment_rules: The Theory and Problems Exam (75%) requires at least 40% of its score for its contribution to the final grade to be non-null. The Completion of Assignments, Cases, or Exercises (10%) contributes between 0 and 1 point and its score is maintained for the extraordinary exam. For Laboratory/field/ICT tool usage practices (15%), attendance of at least 75% of scheduled sessions is mandatory; otherwise, this part must be recovered in the extraordinary exam. The teaching staff may outline a continuous evaluation system for exam and/or lab practice points at the start of the course.
